warnings: Raw UPS_DC_#.csv files require multiplication by 0.1 to convert manufacturer MODBUS values to ampere. This does not authorize blanket rescaling of already-labelled ampere source-data sheets.
Fig7 panel f has missing timestamps/values before update; do not drop missing samples and treat remaining observations as uniformly sampled.

Paper Supplementary Note9 refers to updated battery block1, whereas the changed trace appears in source workbook columns labelled Current3. Preserve literal channel labels; do not infer a one-to-one physical-block mapping.
Source Fig6 waveforms are averaged at 3-second resolution, not measurements of subsecond pulse shapes.
The 2025 arXiv v1 and 2026 final paper differ materially, including Mallorca interpretation and amplitude conventions; use final paper and final supplement.
